body: Marico letter to NSE/BSE 20-Nov-2026: spouse Ms. Vrunda Bhaskar bought 200 shares on 8-Nov-2026 (Rs 1.79 lakh) in the prohibited period (UPSI public 6-Nov; window to 11-Nov); audit committee found it inadvertent; Rs 3 lakh penalty remitted to SEBI IPEF. Minor, properly disclosed.
title: Marico: audit committee levies Rs 3 lakh on independent director Bhaskar Bhat for spouse's closed-window purchase (disclosed 20-Nov-2026)
